sections.name: register
sections.title: Startup environment check
sections.what: When the server starts, it loads the environment checker and runs it, which stops startup if a required setting is missing or invalid. Edge runtimes skip this check.
sections.why: Likely reason: failing at startup is clearer than failing on the first request.
sections.watch_out: Any new required setting must be added to the checker, and a single mistake there stops the whole server from starting.

summary: A startup check that stops the server early if its environment settings are missing or invalid.
purpose: It makes a configuration mistake show up at startup instead of as a failure on the first user request.
why: Likely reason: a missing secret would otherwise cause confusing errors later.
how: When the server starts, it checks whether it is running on the Node runtime. If so, it loads the environment checker and runs it. Otherwise it does nothing.
inputs: The environment settings the server runs with.
outputs: Nothing when the settings are valid. An error that stops startup when they are not.
risks: A new required setting that is not added to the checker will not be caught here.
debug: If the server will not start, read the error from the environment checker and fix the named setting. Check that the server is actually running on the Node runtime.
